events.text: The Judiciary Act creates the U.S. Supreme Court.
Henri Giffard makes the first flight in a powered airship.
Devils Tower in Wyoming becomes the first U.S. national monument.
The Honda Motor Company is founded in Japan.
USS Enterprise, the first nuclear-powered aircraft carrier, is launched.
India's Mangalyaan probe enters orbit around Mars on its first attempt.

births.text: F. Scott Fitzgerald, American author of The Great Gatsby
Howard Florey, Australian pharmacologist who helped develop penicillin
Jim Henson, American creator of the Muppets
